column1: # Nepal postal codes, scheme `np` (D-090, D-105): one row per local level. Schema teigeodata/postal-codes/v1.
# code: the 5-digit local-level code; its wards are code + 01 … code + <parts> (7 digits).
# pcode: the local level in OCHA COD-AB v02 (codab-np-geojson); name: its COD-AB name, for review.
# Codes and ward counts from the GPO table (gpo-np-postal; every build checks them against it).
# The match of GPO rows (Nepali names) to COD-AB units (English names) was made per district by
# name similarity and reviewed by hand: docs/02-research/notes/postal.md §3.9.
